findings: Integer game milliseconds limit distinct pose times to about 60/s at 0.06 speed
Skeletal integration uses cg.frametime updated after entity rendering, while transitions use current cg.time
Server floor writes timescale 0.06 when configured time-bind minimum is 0.05
Time-bind publishes scale in discrete 0.02/0.1 steps
prediction: A fractional presentation clock and same-frame pose delta should reduce steady slow-motion stepping; separate continuous local time scale should reduce transition speed jumps.
limits: Source analysis and live cvars; no controlled motion capture or patch validation. Daemon port 18700 unavailable.
